title: A Generative AI Agent to Emulate Interactive Human-driven Vehicles for Automated Driving Testing in Urban Areas
abstract: arXiv:2611.31797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Realistic modeling of human-driven vehicle (HDV) interactions is essential for automated driving safety testing in urban areas. Existing methods struggle to reproduce realistic safety-critical interactions involving high collision risk for the following reasons: they often assume full observability, overlooking interactions arising from occlusion. Driving styles are mainly characterized by vehicle maneuvers, limiting the diversity of safety-critical interaction behaviors. Moreover, learning signals from safety-critical interactions can be diluted by non-critical driving behaviors. To address these issues, we propose a generative AI agent to emulate interactive HDVs. The agent incorporates field-of-view modeling to account for driver visibility under occlusion and characterizes the interaction process using five metrics spanning its initial, intermediate, and final stages. translated_title: 一种用于城市区域自动驾驶测试、模拟交互式人类驾驶车辆的生成式AI智能体
translated_abstract: 在城市场景中，真实建模人类驾驶车辆的交互行为对于自动驾驶安全测试至关重要。现有方法难以重现涉及高碰撞风险的安全关键交互，原因在于：它们通常假设完全可观测性，忽视了由遮挡引发的交互；驾驶风格主要通过车辆机动动作来表征，限制了安全关键交互行为的多样性；此外，来自安全关键交互的学习信号可能被非关键驾驶行为所稀释。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种生成式AI智能体来模拟交互式人类驾驶车辆。该智能体引入视场建模以考虑遮挡条件下的驾驶员可见性，并使用涵盖交互过程初始、中间和最终阶段的五个指标来刻画交互过程，通过动力学……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种生成式AI智能体，通过视场建模处理遮挡影响，并以五个指标刻画交互全过程的风格，从而真实模拟人类驾驶车辆的安全关键交互行为，服务于城市场景的自动驾驶安全测试。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generative AI agent that incorporates field-of-view modeling to handle occlusion and characterizes interactions across their initial, intermediate, and final stages with five metrics, enabling realistic emulation of safety-critical HDV interactions for automated driving safety testing in urban areas.
